title: Secret-seed strkey (S), a type the SEP's published vectors do not cover
caps_note: A pure encoding rule: SEP-0023 strkey text for a key type that no CAP in this entry's family introduced; the strkey group is cross-cutting
why: SEP-0023 publishes no S vector; this one uses the SEP's key bytes so every decoder is tested on the S version byte with a known payload.
notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/strkey/synthetic-gap-vectors.secret-seed.json. The text was encoded from the stated payload with an independent SEP-0023 encoder (version byte, payload, CRC16-XModem little-endian, RFC 4648 base32 without padding) and decoded back by the same rules; no SDK output was used. Executed in every probe column as vector 9S12 (evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json).
